integrity: The self-contained linear algebra and transfer argument proves the theorem for all stated fields and sizes. A standalone finite prime-field checker verifies instances only; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The general support-rank identity refines standard incidence-matrix reasoning; the proposed distinct contribution is the explicit all-rank finite-field three-state cycle enumerator. Absolute literature priority, higher-degree multiplication, and nonreduced rank schemes are not established.
title: Support-rank spectra and a three-state cycle enumerator for square-zero graph algebras
